summary.name: Paperclip
summary.oneLiner: 開源的 AI 代理團隊編排控制平面，可自架，不需帳號。
highlights: 任何代理、任何執行環境都能接入同一張組織圖，只要能接收 heartbeat 即可被「雇用」
身分與權限：支援受信任本機與需驗證兩種部署模式、人類角色權限、代理 API 金鑰、短效 run JWT、公司成員與邀請流程
以任務、組織、訓練、基礎設施四大支柱組織 AI 代理團隊的工作
useCases: 想把多個 AI 代理組成有組織架構的團隊，分配任務並追蹤產出時
想自架一套 AI 代理管理後台，並控管代理權限與責任歸屬時
summary.demo: 一個網頁儀表板，把 AI 代理排成組織圖：每個代理有角色、預算和任務看板，可以看著它們接工作、完成工作。
summary.why: 有人分享它，是因為能自架、把好幾個寫程式的代理當成一個團隊來管，不用在一堆終端機之間切換。

summary.name: ThinkRail
summary.oneLiner: 以 pi 驅動的輕量 IDE，會依工作習慣自我客製化
highlights: 以 pi agent 進行 vibe coding 的輕量 IDE
介面會依使用者的工作方式自我調整（依頁面描述）
主題標籤標示支援 spec-driven 開發與 agent skills
useCases: 想用 pi agent 寫程式、但偏好輕量 IDE 的開發者
想採用規格驅動（spec-driven）開發流程的人

summary.name: ascii-sharks
summary.oneLiner: 以 TypeScript 在 canvas 上繪製 ASCII 魚與鯊魚的元件庫。
highlights: 在 canvas 上以 ASCII 字元繪製魚與鯊魚
以 TypeScript 撰寫的元件
零依賴，不需安裝其他套件
useCases: 想在網頁加入 ASCII 風格的魚或鯊魚裝飾
需要輕量、無依賴的 TypeScript canvas 繪圖元件
summary.demo: 在瀏覽器的畫布上畫出一群用 ASCII 字元組成的鯊魚與小魚游來游去，可以當成動態背景嵌進網頁。
summary.why: 有人在聊天室分享，說拿來讓首頁更有趣很適合。

summary.name: ai-design-skills
summary.oneLiner: 一組給 AI 寫碼工具用的設計技能（skills）合集，以 markdown 規則檔形式提供。
highlights: 相容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等任何能讀取 markdown 規則檔的工具
設計值（字型、顏色、間距、動效）集中在每個技能檔案底部的同一區段，方便統一修改
可直接複製檔案內容貼到 Settings → Rules for AI 使用，或以資料夾名稱安裝單一技能
useCases: 想讓 AI 寫碼工具產出風格一致的落地頁或網站設計時
想依自家品牌調整設計規範，fork 後修改設計值區段即可沿用

summary.name: Taste Skill
summary.oneLiner: 給 AI 代理使用的前端設計技能包，主打避開千篇一律的 AI 風格。
highlights: 提供程式碼實作類技能，讓 AI 代理輸出前端程式碼
另有影像生成技能，只產出設計參考圖，不含程式碼
透過 npx skills add 安裝，建議先從 taste-skill 開始
useCases: 讓 AI 代理生成前端頁面時，避免套用通用的 AI 設計風格
在 ChatGPT Images 或 Codex 等工具中先產出設計參考圖

summary.name: CleanYourTV
summary.oneLiner: 透過 Wi-Fi 精簡 Android/Google TV，換上 Apple TV 風格首頁
highlights: 透過 Wi-Fi 與 ADB 除錯功能精簡 Android TV / Google TV 的內建應用程式
附原生首頁啟動器，約 532 KB、純 Java，不需網路權限也沒有背景服務
提供手動操作步驟與還原說明；非 Android 電視則有遙控器逐步關閉追蹤的指南
useCases: 想關閉 Android TV / Google TV 的追蹤與預載應用，又不想刷機的人
想在記憶體只有 1GB 的舊電視上換用輕量、簡潔的首頁

zh-TW.title: 出國前先把 Google 地圖下載成離線地圖

summary.name: 離線地圖小技巧
summary.oneLiner: 出國前在 Google 地圖把要去的區域下載下來，沒網路也能導航、查店家。
highlights: 在地圖上搜尋城市 → 點頭像 → 離線地圖 → 選取自己的地圖，框出範圍後下載
下載後沒有網路也能看地圖、開車導航，省下漫遊流量
離線地圖會過期，出發前一天記得更新一次
useCases: 出國旅行、網卡還沒開通的時候
去山區或訊號不好的地方
summary.demo: 一則 Threads 貼文，四張截圖一步一步示範怎麼框選範圍、下載離線地圖。
summary.why: 朋友在群組裡分享，說下個月去日本前要先設定好。

zh-TW.title: 15 分鐘一鍋到底：番茄雞肉義大利麵

summary.name: 一鍋到底番茄雞肉義大利麵
summary.oneLiner: 一支 YouTube 料理教學：只用一個平底鍋，15 分鐘做好晚餐。
highlights: 麵條直接下在番茄醬汁裡煮，不用另外燒一鍋水
材料只要雞腿肉、番茄罐頭、洋蔥、蒜頭和義大利麵
影片最後教怎麼把剩下的做成隔天的便當
useCases: 下班後想快速煮一頓、又不想洗很多鍋子
剛開始學做菜，想找步驟簡單的食譜
summary.demo: 一支約 8 分鐘的影片，從切菜到上桌全程示範，畫面上有每個步驟的時間。
summary.why: 家人傳到群組說「這週來試試」。

zh-TW.title: 讓爸媽手機更好用的 5 個免費 App

summary.name: 讓爸媽手機更好用的 5 個免費 App
summary.oneLiner: 一篇文章，推薦 5 個免費 App，幫長輩把手機字放大、防詐騙、找回手機。
highlights: 教你把手機字體和圖示放大，設定簡易模式
推薦來電辨識 App，陌生電話會先標出可能的詐騙
開啟「尋找我的手機」和家人共享位置，手機掉了找得回來
useCases: 幫爸媽換新手機、想一次設定好的時候
家裡長輩常接到可疑電話
summary.demo: 一篇圖文文章，每個 App 附一張設定畫面截圖和下載連結。
summary.why: 過年回家要幫爸媽設定手機，先存起來。

summary.name: Paperclip
summary.oneLiner: Open-source, self-hosted control plane for orchestrating teams of AI agents.
highlights: Bring Your Own Agent: any runtime that can receive a heartbeat can be added to one org chart
useCases: Running a team of autonomous AI agents as an organization with an org chart and assigned tasks
Self-hosting a managed workspace where humans and agents share roles, permissions, and attribution
summary.demo: A web dashboard with an org chart of agents: each one has a role, a budget and a task board, and you watch them pick up and finish work.
summary.why: Shared as a self-hosted way to run several coding agents as one team instead of juggling terminals.

summary.name: ThinkRail
summary.oneLiner: Apache-2.0 agentic IDE for vibe coding with pi, living specs, and git worktree workspaces.
highlights: Opens any git repo as a project and creates isolated workspaces as git worktrees
Ships as a desktop installer and a standalone thinkrail CLI, with SHA256 checksum verification in the installer
Learns the project through living specs (spec-driven development)
useCases: Vibe coding on a git repo inside a lightweight IDE built around the pi agent
Running separate tasks in isolated git worktree workspaces cut from one repo

summary.name: ascii-sharks
summary.oneLiner: TypeScript components that draw fish and sharks as ASCII art on a canvas.
highlights: Draws fish and sharks as ASCII characters on a canvas
Zero dependencies
Written in TypeScript and released under the MIT license
useCases: Adding ASCII shark or fish art to a TypeScript web project's canvas
Dependency-free ASCII art experiments
summary.demo: Draws a school of ASCII-art sharks and fish swimming across a browser canvas; you can embed it as an animated background.
summary.why: Someone shared it in the chat as a fun way to liven up a landing page.

summary.name: AI Design Skills
summary.oneLiner: MIT-licensed collection of design skill files for AI coding tools that read rules.
highlights: Each skill is a self-contained folder with a SKILL.md file to copy into a tool's project rules
Design values (fonts, colors, spacing, motion) sit in one editable section near the bottom of each skill
useCases: Giving an AI coding assistant consistent design guidance when building landing pages or UI
Forking the repo to customize a team's fonts, colors, and spacing for AI-generated front-end work

summary.name: Taste Skill
summary.oneLiner: Front-end design skills for AI agents, built to avoid the same generic AI look.
highlights: Code skills that have an AI agent write the front-end code
Separate image-generation skills that only produce design reference pictures, no code
Installs with npx skills add; start with taste-skill
useCases: Keeping an AI agent from falling back on the usual generic AI design when it builds a page
Making design reference pictures first in tools like ChatGPT Images or Codex

summary.name: cleanyourtv
summary.oneLiner: Debloats Android/Google TVs over Wi-Fi and installs a lightweight Apple TV-style home screen.
highlights: Removes bloatware over network ADB on port 5555 using Python 3 scripts (tools/tv.py), with no extra dependencies
Native Android TV launcher of about 532 KB in plain Java, built for 1 GB RAM TVs
Launcher has no blur, video, network permission, or background services; includes a restore section
useCases: Speeding up a slow Android TV or Google TV by stripping preinstalled apps
Replacing a cluttered TV home screen with a minimal, Apple TV-style one

en.title: Download Google Maps for offline use before a trip

summary.name: Offline maps tip
summary.oneLiner: Before you travel, download the area in Google Maps so directions and place search work without data.
highlights: Search the city → tap your profile picture → Offline maps → Select your own map, frame the area and download
Once downloaded, maps and driving directions work with no connection, so no roaming charges
Offline maps expire: update them the day before you leave
useCases: Travelling abroad before your SIM is working
Heading to the mountains or anywhere with weak signal
summary.demo: A Threads post with four screenshots showing, step by step, how to frame an area and download it.
summary.why: A friend shared it in the group chat to set up before next month's trip to Japan.

summary.name: One-pan tomato chicken pasta
summary.oneLiner: A YouTube cooking tutorial: dinner in 15 minutes using a single pan.
highlights: The pasta cooks right in the tomato sauce, no separate pot of water
Only needs chicken thighs, canned tomatoes, an onion, garlic and pasta
The end of the video shows how to turn leftovers into the next day's lunch
useCases: A quick dinner after work without a pile of pots to wash
Learning to cook and looking for a recipe with simple steps
summary.demo: An 8-minute video that goes from chopping to plating, with the time for each step on screen.
summary.why: A family member posted it to the group: “let's try this one this week.”

en.title: 5 free apps that make your parents' phone easier to use

summary.name: 5 free apps that make your parents' phone easier
summary.oneLiner: An article recommending five free apps that enlarge text, flag scam calls and help find a lost phone.
highlights: Shows how to make text and icons bigger and turn on a simple mode
Recommends a caller-ID app that marks likely scam calls before you pick up
Turns on Find My Phone and location sharing with family, so a lost phone can be found
useCases: Setting up a new phone for your parents in one go
Older family members who keep getting suspicious calls
summary.demo: An illustrated article with a screenshot of each app's settings and a download link.
summary.why: Saved to set up Mom and Dad's phones on the next visit home.
